title: fix(drill): "Open in list" is offered only when the list can show exactly the drawer's records
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu4M8GSzQt9g91oqAEXonaaD)_

Fixes #30654

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：仪表盘和报表下钻抽屉里的「在列表中打开」，以及 `drillDown.target: 'navigate'`，现在只有列表页的 URL 能把下钻筛选原样写出来时才给出口；写不全就不给，留在抽屉里。
- 为什么改：下钻筛选 = 点中的分组 ∧ 组件筛选 ∧ 度量的下钻范围。URL 一个参数只能放一个值、也写不了 `$in`，以前会丢掉条件，打开的列表比抽屉里的数字更宽（抽屉 0 张发票，列表 4 张）。
- 风险与回滚：只影响下钻出口是否显示；单条件等值和日期区间下钻的 URL 逐字节不变。布尔值分组的下钻现在也不再给出口（沿用相关列表「查看全部」的同一条精确规则）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/useOpenRecordList.ts`（`drillRecordListFilter`、`useRecordListDrillNavigation`）、`ui/packages/react/src/context/DrillNavigationContext.tsx`（新可选成员）、`ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx` 的两处守卫。
- 两分钟验证：app-showcase「Revenue Pulse (filtered)」→「Paid Rate by Status」表格 → Sent 行的 Paid Invoices 格子：抽屉 0 行，右上角没有「在列表中打开」；同一行的发票数格子仍有，点开 URL 是 `filter[status]=sent` 加组件的日期区间。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/react`: `DrillNavigationValue` gains an optional `canOpenRecordList(objectName, filter): boolean`. Absent means the host claims every filter it is handed has an exact destination, which is how hosts behaved before.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: `useRecordListDrillNavigation()` returns `{ openRecordList, canOpenRecordList }` for `DashboardView` and `ReportView`. Both go through the new pure `drillRecordListFilter`, which resolves placeholders first (`resolveFilterPlaceholders` with the same `useFilterScope` scope the navigate arm always used), then asks `exactRecordListFilter` (reused unchanged, with `usePermissions().checkField(object, field, 'read')`). `openRecordList` navigates to the exact filter and does nothing when there is none, so a caller that skipped the question still never lands on a wider list. `useOpenRecordList` stays as the navigate half.
- `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`: `OpenInListButton` renders nothing, and `DrillDownDrawer`'s `navigateOnly` is false, when `canOpenRecordList` answers `false`. The drill then stays in the drawer, the same fallback as a host with no `openRecordList`.
- `@object-ui/plugin-charts`: `ObjectChart`'s navigate arm and its own drawer-header "Open in list" ask the same question (with `drillFilter` and `merged` respectively).
- The 13 `DashboardView` / `ReportView` tests that mock `./useOpenRecordList` now mock `useRecordListDrillNavigation` instead (mechanical, same `vi.fn()` opener).
- One changeset: patch for the four packages (`Metadata-protocol: none` ⇒ patch; `Clause-②: yes (widening)` for the new optional interface member, per the claim amendment).

Answers to the claim's two questions:
- A `drillDown.target: 'navigate'` click with no exact destination opens the in-place drawer (no navigation, no dead click).
- Placeholders are resolved before the exactness check, inside `drillRecordListFilter`, with the scope `useOpenRecordList` already read; a `{current_user_id}` that resolves to the same value as a bucket on the same field is one exact param (pinned).

## Tests

New pins:
- `useOpenRecordList.placeholderScope-9022.test.tsx`, new top-level describe (6 cases): the repro shape `composeDrillFilter({ status: 'paid' }, { status: 'sent' })` answers `false` and `openRecordList` does not navigate; an `$in` scope answers `false`; a plain equality bucket answers `true` and opens byte-for-byte `/apps/crm/invoice/data?filter%5Bstatus%5D=sent`; the same condition twice is one param; placeholders resolve before judging; an unreadable field answers `false`. The file's existing CONTROL (equality + date range URL pinned as a whole string) stays green unchanged.
- `DrillDownDrawer.escapeHatch.test.tsx`, new top-level describe (4 cases): host answers `false` ⇒ no button, asked with the drill filter; `navigate` stays in the drawer; host answers `true` ⇒ button; host without `canOpenRecordList` ⇒ old behaviour for both the button and `navigate`.
- `ObjectChart.drillNavigate.test.tsx`, new top-level describe (2 cases): host answers `false` ⇒ drawer, no header button; host answers `true` ⇒ navigates. The file's existing four cases (no `canOpenRecordList`) are the unchanged-host control.

Ablation (each on the committed fix, restored to the HEAD blob by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; the tests import the source relatively, no `dist/` involved):

| Mutation | Result |
|:---|:---|
| delete the `OpenInListButton` guard | 1 failed / 7 (host answers false case) |
| `DrillDownDrawer` `navigateOnly` guard → `true` | 1 failed / 7 (navigate stays in drawer) |
| `ObjectChart` navigate guard → `true` | 1 failed / 6 |
| `ObjectChart` header-button guard → `true` | 1 failed / 6 |
| `drillRecordListFilter` returns the resolved filter unjudged | 3 failed / 12 (repro, `$in`, unreadable field) |

## Acceptance notes

- `exactRecordListFilter` is reused unchanged, so its refusals now apply to drills too: a drill on a boolean bucket (`{ is_paid: true }`), on `$ne`, on a text operator, or with a placeholder that cannot resolve to a comparand the route carries no longer offers "Open in list" (the drawer still lists the records). Before, those opened a list scoped by a string comparand or with the condition dropped.
- `ReportView`'s group-key fallback drill (older server with no drill metadata) goes through the same host, so it is judged the same way.
- The PR carries no assignee or reviewer: the seat sets them at hand-over.
- Branch is the card thread's harness branch (`claude/project-thread-qgekwo`, claim amendment 6671583364), not `claude/issue-30654-*`.

## Verification

Live, app-showcase on its own port (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`), Console via Vite, headless Chromium at 1440 px. "Revenue Pulse (filtered)" → "Paid Rate by Status", Sent row (`Sent 4 0 0.0%`):

| | Paid Invoices cell drawer | "Open in list" there | Invoice count cell "Open in list" URL |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| before (the seven source files at `origin/main`) | 0 rows | shown | `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_invoice/data?filter%5Bissued_on%5D%5Bgte%5D=2026-08-07&filter%5Bissued_on%5D%5Blte%5D=2026-11-05&filter%5Bstatus%5D=sent` |
| after | 0 rows | absent | identical string |
